description: Implementation of a TCP socket class for the Starboard platform, including socket creation, binding, listening, accepting connections, connecting, reading, writing, and socket configuration.

classes.name: TCPSocketStarboard
classes.description: A TCP socket implementation for the Starboard platform, supporting socket operations such as open, bind, listen, accept, connect, read, write, and configuration.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Creates a new TCP socket with the specified address family.

methods.name: AdoptConnectedSocket
methods.description: Adopts an existing connected socket and peer address.

methods.name: AdoptUnconnectedSocket
methods.description: Adopts an existing unconnected socket.

methods.name: Bind
methods.description: Binds the socket to a local address.

methods.name: Listen
methods.description: Marks the socket as listening for incoming connections.

methods.name: Accept
methods.description: Accepts an incoming connection.

methods.name: SetDefaultOptionsForServer
methods.description: Sets default socket options for server mode.

methods.name: SetDefaultOptionsForClient
methods.description: Sets default socket options for client mode.

methods.name: AcceptInternal
methods.description: Internal method to accept a connection.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the socket and cleans up resources.

methods.name: StopWatchingAndCleanUp
methods.description: Stops socket event watching and resets internal state.

methods.name: OnSocketReadyToRead
methods.description: Callback when socket is ready to read.

methods.name: OnSocketReadyToWrite
methods.description: Callback when socket is ready to write.

methods.name: Connect
methods.description: Initiates a connection to a remote address.

methods.name: HandleConnectCompleted
methods.description: Handles completion of connect operation.

methods.name: DidCompleteConnect
methods.description: Completes the connection process.

methods.name: StartLoggingMultipleConnectAttempts
methods.description: Begins logging multiple connection attempts.

methods.name: IsConnected
methods.description: Checks if socket is connected.

methods.name: IsConnectedAndIdle
methods.description: Checks if socket is connected and idle.

methods.name: EndLoggingMultipleConnectAttempts
methods.description: Ends logging of multiple connection attempts.

methods.name: LogConnectBegin
methods.description: Logs the start of a connection attempt.

methods.name: LogConnectEnd
methods.description: Logs the end of a connection attempt.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads data from the socket.

methods.name: ReadIfReady
methods.description: Reads data if socket is ready.

methods.name: CancelReadIfReady
methods.description: Cancels a pending read if ready operation.

methods.name: RetryRead
methods.description: Retries reading data.

methods.name: DoRead
methods.description: Performs the actual read operation.

methods.name: DidCompleteRead
methods.description: Completes a read operation.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes data to the socket.

methods.name: DoWrite
methods.description: Performs the actual write operation.

methods.name: DidCompleteWrite
methods.description: Completes a write operation.

methods.name: SetReceiveBufferSize
methods.description: Sets the receive buffer size.

methods.name: SetSendBufferSize
methods.description: Sets the send buffer size.

methods.name: SetKeepAlive
methods.description: Enables or disables TCP keep-alive.

methods.name: SetNoDelay
methods.description: Enables or disables TCP no-delay (Nagle's algorithm).

methods.name: GetEstimatedRoundTripTime
methods.description: Retrieves estimated round-trip time (not implemented).

methods.name: GetLocalAddress
methods.description: Gets the local address of the socket.

methods.name: GetPeerAddress
methods.description: Gets the remote peer address.

methods.name: DetachFromThread
methods.description: Detaches the object from the current thread.

methods.name: ReleaseSocketDescriptorForTesting
methods.description: Releases the socket descriptor for testing purposes.

methods.name: SocketDescriptorForTesting
methods.description: Returns the current socket descriptor for testing.

methods.name: ApplySocketTag
methods.description: Applies a socket tag.

methods.name: ClearReadWatcherIfOperationsNotPending
methods.description: Clears read watcher if no read operations are pending.

methods.name: ClearWriteWatcherIfOperationsNotPending
methods.description: Clears write watcher if no write operations are pending.

methods.name: BindToNetwork
methods.description: Bind socket to a specific network (not implemented).

methods.name: SetIPv6Only
methods.description: Set IPv6 only mode (not implemented).
